load_sentinel1_ic: load a Sentinel-1 GRD ImageCollection filtered by mode, polarization, and orbit direction
load_sentinel2_ic: load a Sentinel-2 harmonized ImageCollection in L2A or L1C mode with cloud filtering
mask_sentinel2_clouds: apply cloud masking to a Sentinel-2 image using QA60 bits or cloud probability bands
load_landsat_ic: load a Landsat 7, 8, or 9 ImageCollection with optional radiance calibration and cloud filtering
load_modis_vegetation: load MODIS Terra vegetation index data (NDVI, EVI) at 250m, 500m, or 1km resolution
load_hansen_forest_change: load the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset with tree cover, loss, and gain bands
load_elevation_dem: load elevation, slope, and aspect from NASADEM, FABDEM, or Copernicus DEM sources
load_gedi_canopy: load GEDI rasterized canopy height or structure data with optional quality flag filtering
load_land_cover: load land cover data from DynamicWorld, ESA WorldCover, NLCD, or Global Consensus sources
load_custom_fc: load a custom FeatureCollection with configurable filters, buffering, and property settings
load_custom_image: load a custom Earth Engine image by asset name with an optional transformation function
stack_bands: stack selected bands from a dictionary into an HWC numpy array for visualization
vis_normalize: normalize a numpy image array to 0-1 range using dataset-specific min, max, and gamma values
load_population_data: load population grid data from CIESIN GPW, WorldPop, or GHS-POP sources
load_ecoregions_fc: load the 2017 Ecoregions FeatureCollection or country boundaries with name filtering
